designRules: Provide product, brand relationship and industry task routes in parallel.
Treat brand relationship as structured evidence, not a decorative logo wall.
Translate each industry card into a real process task and next action.
Bind every trust number to date, scope, source and verification status.
Use equipment imagery for context; provide static and reduced-motion fallbacks.
